title: fd_release zeroes outbuf_cap bytes not outbuf_len — correct for stale tail data
description: Why it is right: crypto2dev_fd_release() calls memzero_explicit(state->outbuf, state->outbuf_cap) not memzero_explicit(state->outbuf, state->outbuf_len). krealloc() may reuse memory that held sensitive data from a prior allocation. The unfilled tail between outbuf_len and outbuf_cap could contain residual bytes from prior slab use. FIPS 140-3 zeroization applies to any memory that held key material or derived output, not just the portion written this session. What a reviewer might suggest: 'only zero what you wrote (outbuf_len) to avoid wasted work.' For non-sensitive buffers this would be correct; for FIPS output material the tail must also be zeroed.
